brief:
Pro-Palestine demonstrators gathered in Sydney to call on the Australian government to take stronger action against Israel, according to Al Jazeera English. The protesters urged officials to increase pressure on the country, though specific demands were not detailed in available reports.

The demonstration reflects ongoing activism in Australia over the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with civil society groups continuing to mobilize public support for policy shifts on the issue.
dek: A pro-Palestine protest in Sydney demanded that the Australian government take further action and implement on Israel.
title: Sydney protesters demand Australia increase pressure on Israel
